newsitem.title: INDIA: India Bombay exchange says trade delayed.
newsitem.headline: India Bombay exchange says trade delayed.

text.p: India's Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) on Wednesday said trading at the exchange had been delayed due to a technical problem. It was unable to give any time when trading was expected to begin.
Blue chips at Bombay exchanges were expected to open sharply higher on Wednesday after the decision of former finance minister P. Chidambaram's regional party to rejoin the government, traders said.
G.K. Moopanar, leader of the Tamil Maanila Congress (TMC), said late on Tuesday that the party had decided to join Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral's one week-old government.
